Rover.com connects pet parents with trusted pet care and builds safe, personalized experiences for pets and their people. The Entry Level Software Engineer will join the Recommendations team to develop and launch marketplace features, partnering with senior engineers and collaborating with analysts, designers, and data scientists on search, personalization, and machine learning initiatives.

Lending

Responsibilities
Improving and maintaining the technology behind the search platform, Elasticsearch
Increasing match personalization and pet parent confidence through creative information collection and playback initiatives
Providing engineering support to Data Science as they innovate on the algorithm and ML models that support search
Partner closely with senior engineers to break down requirements, build features, and see them through to launch -- growing your skills as a professional developer along the way

Software Development

Two-Sided Marketplaces

For this reason, candidates must be based in the Greater Seattle Area
Additionally, applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis, without the need for current or future employer sponsorship for an employment-based visa status
• 1-4 years as a professional software developer
• Graduation from a formal computer science or engineering program
• Experience utilizing AI tools to drive both technical and non-technical workflows
• A solid foundation in professional software development practices and system design
• A strong communicator who can build consensus around technical approaches, address ambiguity with stakeholders, and effectively present information
• A high bar for code quality, automated testing, and engineering best practices
• Aligned with Rover Core Values
Preferred
Plus: Experience with any of the technologies we support - Python/Django, Elasticsearch, React/React Native
Plus: Experience working in a relevant domain - search or two-sided marketplaces
